** DRIVER'S LICENSING WILL NOT BE RETURNING TO TURNER COUNTY **
​After reaching out to State, Turner County has been made aware that for the foreseeable future, there is no intention for
Driver's Licensing to return
​

* TREASURER'S OFFICE - NO TRANSACTIONS STARTED AFTER 4:00 PM
SHERIFF'S OFFICE: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM
CLERK OF COURTS: 8:00 AM - 4:30 PM

Turner County Food Pantry
Location: Back Entrance of 238 N. Main Ave - Parker ​
Hours: Wednesdays & Fridays from 10am - 12pm.

In order to serve everyone with a need, we ask that you limit your use of the pantry to one time per month.

Turner County Fair
The oldest county fair in the state, t he Turner County Fair is a free gate four day fair in August. We pride ourselves on our wide array of 4-H exhibits, specialty food, commercial exhibits, midway, and contests that are sure to delight.
The fair gives local 4-H members the opportunity to showcase their projects while also serving as an unofficial end to summer with four fun-filled days before summer ends and school starts. Learn more from our Extension Office!

Remembering and Honoring Those Who Serve
Serving rural Turner County and cities of Parker, Marion, Hurley, Centerville, Monroe, Davis and Dolton, the Turner County Sheriff's Office are dedicated to serve and protect the life and property of all full-time citizens, part-time citizens, and visitors of Turner County.
